sources_note: Official names, descriptions and grades are as PlayStation publishes them, as carried by Exophase and PSNProfiles. Guide steps are drawn from PowerPyx's GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap and cross-checked against the full trophy lists on Sixshore, One More Game, GameMapa and GTA Spotter; each trophy below names its sources.

roadmap.title: Play the story — 60 to 80 hours
roadmap.text: Play Chapters 1 to 5 in order and take optional missions as they appear — purple icons, and black icons with pink letters. Scan every new vehicle with the WAiNK app and study animals through binoculars as you travel; progress you make during the story already counts toward the 100% checklist. Do the Chapter 1 balcony meditation for Positive Mental Attitude before leaving Chapter 1 — it is the only potentially missable trophy. Keep a manual save at the start and end of every chapter: there is no mission replay. Keep cheats off — they disable trophies and saving.

roadmap.title: The 100% checklist — about 100 hours
roadmap.text: After the credits, Progress > Stats gains a 100% Completion entry. Work through it: 200 of 277 vehicles, 100 of 255 animals, 50 of 66 weapons, 70 of 80 challenges, plus every robbery, underwater discovery, shooting range, drone race and Bret quest. The checklist is lenient — about 60% true completion — so this is where Cunning Stunts, The Shootist, Top Fun, Don't Touch My Deck, You WAiNKer!, Whip It Good, The Goodtime State, Maximum Withdrawal and Pest Control all pop.

roadmap.title: Strangers & Freaks and side strands — about 10 hours
roadmap.text: Finish the 8 stranger strands and the contact questlines — Andy (Lucia-only), Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone (Jason-only). Quest givers tied to trophies return after the story. Sweep up the activity and combat trophies: fishing with Cal, the arcade, bowling, the meditation spots, hunting for Bret, the partner robberies and the wanted-level escapes.

roadmap.title: Money and property
roadmap.text: Launder $250,000 of Marked Bills through your contacts, spend $100,000 across all shops, buy all 8 garage properties and register 10 vehicles in the Scooter Bros app. This is mostly a by-product of the robbery grind — if you are short at the end, buy expensive cars or weapons to close the gap, then keep laundering.

roadmap.title: Platinum
roadmap.text: With the other 54 trophies earned, Vice Got a Price! pops on its own. Check A Long Road's 100% first — it is the last gold and the hardest trophy — then confirm the count in this tracker: 54 of 54, and the platinum is yours.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Unlocks automatically once the other 54 trophies are yours — there is no separate task. PowerPyx rates the whole run at about 200 hours and 4/10 difficulty, all offline, in a single playthrough. Finish the story, work the 100% checklist, then mop up Strangers & Freaks and the miscellaneous trophies; this one pops last, by itself.

sources.name: Sixshore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Story trophy for finishing the opening mission, Gone Fishing. Just play through the intro with Jason and Lucia; it pops when the mission ends and cannot be missed. It is the first trophy most players earn, and the roadmap starts here.

sources.name: One More Game — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophy List

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 1. Story chapters unlock in order, so keep playing the main missions; the trophy pops at the chapter's end. GTA VI has no mission replay, so keep a manual save at the start of each chapter, as PowerPyx advises, in case you want to revisit anything later.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 2. Automatic story trophy at the end of the chapter. By now Lucia is playable for some missions; the last meditation spot also needs both characters, so do not rush past side content you spot along the way.

sources.name: GTA Spotter — GTA VI trophies and achievements

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3. Automatic at the chapter's end. Keep scanning new vehicles with the WAiNK app as you go — the 100% checklist later asks for 200 of 277 base models, and progress made during the story already counts.

sources.name: Sixshore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4. Automatic at the chapter's end. Bank vault jobs open through an optional mission in this chapter, so take optional missions — purple icons, and black icons with pink letters — as they appear.

sources.name: One More Game — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophy List

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Finish the final mission. Automatic story trophy; after the credits the game returns you to free-roam and the 100% Completion checklist appears under Progress > Stats. Cheats only unlock after the story, and they disable trophies and saving, so keep them off your platinum save.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Breakfast Run. A story mission — follow the main-mission markers until it appears and play it through; the trophy pops when the mission ends. With no mission replay, keep a save at the chapter start if you want a record of the mission.

sources.name: GTA Spotter — GTA VI trophies and achievements

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete the mission The Cartel Heist. A story mission on the main path — one of the big set-piece heists — and the trophy pops when the mission completes. Unmissable as long as you play the story through.

sources.name: Sixshore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Child's Play. A story mission on the main path; the trophy pops when the mission ends.

sources.name: One More Game — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophy List

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Headliners. A story mission on the main path; the trophy pops when the mission ends.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete the mission VCIA Takedown. A story mission at the airport; the trophy pops when the mission ends. The airport itself stays open afterwards, which matters for the Catch Me If You Can trophy.

sources.name: GTA Spotter — GTA VI trophies and achievements

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Operation Savage Glory. A story mission on the main path; the trophy pops when the mission ends.

sources.name: Sixshore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% on the in-game completion checklist, which appears under Progress > Stats after the story. PowerPyx's key point: the checklist is lenient, closer to 60% true completion. You need 200 of 277 vehicles, 100 of 255 animals studied, 50 of 66 weapons, 70 of 80 challenges, plus every robbery, underwater discovery, shooting range, drone race and Bret quest. This is the longest trophy and the last gold before the platinum.

sources.name: One More Game — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophy List

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts of any kind — stunt jumps, flights under bridges, knife flights and base jumps. PowerPyx counts 397 stunts in total, and 100% completion needs 300, so this pops on the way to that. Stunts are tracked in your stats; mix types rather than grinding one jump.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball, a video game, a race and a stunt — PowerPyx's list. You do not need to win or finish anything; one try of each counts. Most pop naturally during the 100% run, so check the list early and tick off any type you have not touched.

sources.name: GTA Spotter — GTA VI trophies and achievements

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Ranges are found across Leonida; each challenge is a short timed shooting drill. Gold needs accuracy and speed — use a weapon you control well and redo a challenge until the gold medal registers. All 42 are also required for 100%.

sources.name: Sixshore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every one of the 14 locations. Drone races are time trials through gates; learn a course's line before pushing for the win. A win at each location is what counts, not one fast time, and every location is also required for 100%.

sources.name: One More Game — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophy List

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — street, off-road and water races all count, but each race only counts once. Take the faster car or boat for the course, and work through the race list in the map menu so you do not repeat one you already won.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Find Cal at a fishing spot and take his challenge; fishing is timing-based — wait for the bite, then reel steadily without snapping the line. You can retry the challenge if you lose, so it is never missable.

sources.name: GTA Spotter — GTA VI trophies and achievements

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete one arcade game. Arcades are in bars and clubs around Leonida — walk up to a machine and play a full game through to its end screen. Any machine counts, and it also ticks off one of the 9 activity types for Master of None.

sources.name: Sixshore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy. Andy's questline is Lucia-only, so play it as Lucia when the missions appear. The strand can be finished after the story — quest givers tied to trophies return in free-roam.

sources.name: One More Game — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophy List

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton. Follow Kenton's strand to its last mission. Like the other contact strands it can be finished after the story ends.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy. Follow Billy's strand to its last mission; it can be finished after the story.

sources.name: GTA Spotter — GTA VI trophies and achievements

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. Stranger missions appear as ? icons and side strands on the map; only some questlines count, and PowerPyx is still confirming exactly which — play every stranger strand you find, and this pops at the eighth. They can all be done after the story.

sources.name: Sixshore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy. Follow Randy's strand to its last mission; finishable after the story.

sources.name: One More Game — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophy List

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone. Tyrone's questline is Jason-only — play it as Jason when the missions appear. Finishable after the story, like the other contact strands.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.missableNote: The only potentially missable trophy. The first meditation — at Jason's house in Chapter 1, after the mission Down to Earth, when Lucia suggests meditating on the balcony in the morning — becomes permanently unavailable after Chapter 1, and there is no mission replay. Do it before leaving Chapter 1.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every one of the 18 meditation spots across Leonida. The first spot is the one to protect: at Jason's house in Chapter 1, after the mission Down to Earth, Lucia suggests meditating on the balcony in the morning — accept and complete it before leaving Chapter 1, because that spot becomes unavailable and there is no mission replay. The last spot only opens once you can play as both characters, after Coffee Break in Chapter 2. PowerPyx flags this as the game's only potentially missable trophy.

sources.name: GTA Spotter — GTA VI trophies and achievements

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret's quests are part of the 100% checklist too, so follow his strand; the unique animal is a specific marked target, not a random hunt. Study animals through binoculars along the way — 100% needs 100 of 255 studied.

sources.name: Sixshore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 collectible card sets out of 18. Cards are scattered across Leonida — in shops, interiors and hidden spots. You only need 3 full sets, so focus on the sets whose cards you keep finding rather than chasing all 18.

sources.name: One More Game — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophy List

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK phone app at 100 locations — landmarks, curiosities and sculptures all count. Open WAiNK near a point of interest and scan it; the app marks what counts. Scan vehicles too while you travel: 100% needs 200 of 277 base models.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges. The game has 80 challenges in eight groups of ten; 100% needs 70, so this pops on the way. Pick the easy groups first and skip the hardest ones — you have 10 to spare for the checklist.

sources.name: GTA Spotter — GTA VI trophies and achievements

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, build a 4-star wanted level and then lose it and escape. Get the cops' attention with your partner in the car or on foot, then break line of sight — hide in an alley, switch vehicles, or get out of the search area until the stars clear. The trophy pops when the heat is fully gone.

sources.name: Sixshore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your wanted level. Plan a route past three shops, keep your partner with you, and move fast between robberies so the wanted level never drops. Do not stop to fight the police — keep moving.

sources.name: One More Game — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophy List

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. New vehicle models count when you first drive or scan them; the WAiNK app helps track what you have found. 100% needs 200 of 277 base models, so keep scanning everything new during the story and this pops early in the cleanup.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Combat Focus is the slow-motion aiming mode — trigger it in a firefight with at least five enemies close together, and line up headshots while time is slowed. A gang shootout or a police chase with several officers is the easiest setup.

sources.name: GTA Spotter — GTA VI trophies and achievements

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA — the airport. Take a plane, or otherwise leave the airport grounds without going through a normal departure; the trophy is about an improvised exit. The airport is open after the story, so try it in free-roam with a fast vehicle or a stolen plane.

sources.name: Sixshore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: The description is a joke about Rhinos — the tank. Get into a Rhino tank (they appear at high wanted levels and at military spots) and cause mayhem with it. The trophy is tied to using the tank; expect the full police response while you do it.

sources.name: One More Game — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophy List

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Go in quietly — no alarms, no witnesses raising the alarm. Scout the store first, move when staff look away, and leave before anyone spots you. If you are seen, leave and try again later.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape. Bank jobs open through an optional mission in Chapter 4; there are 8 vaults in total and 100% needs all of them, so this pops on the way. Plan each vault's escape route before you go in.

sources.name: GTA Spotter — GTA VI trophies and achievements

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Armored trucks drive set routes around Leonida — stop one, break it open, take the cash and lose the wanted level. Trucks respawn, so you can retry as often as you need.

sources.name: Sixshore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida — every named area of the map. Drive, fly or sail through each region until the map is filled in; the in-game stats show which areas are still unvisited. Pair this with WAiNK scanning and vehicle discovery to avoid backtracking.

sources.name: One More Game — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophy List

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each gang — 9 gangs, 9 operations. Gang operations are marked on the map once you find them; hit one per gang. These also count toward the 100% checklist's robbery requirements.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Go to a bar on Ocean Beach, order a cocktail and take in the view — a quiet moment trophy. Any time after the area opens works; it is a nod to the series' opening moments.

sources.name: GTA Spotter — GTA VI trophies and achievements

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Drive a car through the showroom's glass front and out the other side — the trophy wants the dramatic exit, not a careful one. Pick a sturdy, fast car and a straight line through.

sources.name: Sixshore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Play a full game at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley — follow-through on every throw until the game ends. The alley is on the map; any completed game counts, and bowling is also one of the 9 activity types for Master of None.

sources.name: One More Game — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophy List

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal. This one is tied to your in-game social following with your partner — build the partnership's following through the phone's social app and shared activities. Guide writers are still pinning down the exact number, so check the linked PowerPyx guide before grinding it.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Choices made (for better or worse). This tracks the story choices you make across the game — play the story and make the big decisions as they come. With no mission replay, keep a manual save at the start of each chapter so a choice can be revisited if a later guide confirms one matters.

sources.name: GTA Spotter — GTA VI trophies and achievements

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. This pops when something works on the second attempt — the exact trigger is still being confirmed by guide writers. The safest read: if an activity or challenge offers a retry, take it; check the linked guide for the confirmed trigger before going out of your way.

sources.name: Sixshore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? A hidden world event — an odd encounter somewhere in Leonida. These one-off sights are found by exploring odd corners of the map at odd hours; the linked guides track which event pops this trophy as players confirm it.

sources.name: One More Game — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophy List

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by — knock someone down with a melee attack from a moving vehicle. Drive slowly past a pedestrian, swing a melee weapon from the driver's seat, and connect. It may take a few tries to land the hit at speed.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies; hand them to your laundering contacts and the clean money counts toward the total. Keep robbing and laundering during the cleanup — it adds up across the whole game.

sources.name: GTA Spotter — GTA VI trophies and achievements

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Weapons, clothes, cars, food — every shop purchase counts, and the total is cumulative across the game. If you are short near the end, buy expensive cars or weapons to close the gap.

sources.name: Sixshore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties — 8 in total. Garages are bought from property signs around Leonida; each one also gives you storage for your vehicle collection. Save up during the money grind and buy them all.

sources.name: One More Game — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophy List

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Open the app on your phone, pick a vehicle you own or find, and register it. Ten different vehicles is all it takes — use the cars you already collect for Whip It Good.
